events.preview_text: Plan posts across channels, then use post performance to shape your next batch.
events.body:
Queue a few posts for the week, then check how they performed before planning the next batch.

Buffer is a social media workspace for scheduling posts across your connected channels and reviewing the results. After your posts publish, Insights includes a sortable Performance per Post view, helping you see which content performed best.

The Free plan lets you connect **up to three channels** and keep **10 scheduled posts per channel** in the queue at a time. When a post publishes, that slot becomes available again.

Compare the official plans to see whether those Free limits fit your weekly queue or whether a paid option makes more sense.

Start the week by queueing a few posts across the social channels you want to use. Once they publish, check basic post performance before planning the next batch.

Buffer is a social media workspace for planning, scheduling, and reviewing posts. In Insights, the sortable Performance per Post view helps you identify which published content performed best.

The Free plan connects up to **three channels** and holds **10 scheduled posts per channel** at a time. Each slot becomes available again after its post publishes, so you can see whether that entry point fits your weekly queue.

The official comparison shows Free alongside the paid options, so you can choose based on your channels and queue needs.

Buffer is a social media workspace where you can queue a few posts across connected channels, let them publish, and check how they performed.

For a compact weekly routine, schedule the coming week’s posts in one sitting. On Free, you can keep up to **10 scheduled posts per channel**, and each published post opens that slot again.

events.subject: What Buffer Free lets you review
events.preview_text: Schedule within the stated limit, then compare published posts by engagement rate.
events.body:
A weekly test can stay small: schedule a few posts, let them publish, then use the results when choosing the next batch.

Buffer is a social media workspace for scheduling posts across connected channels and checking how they performed. On the Free plan, you can keep up to **10 posts scheduled per channel**; each published post opens that slot again.

If you include Insights in the test, its Performance per Post table sorts published content by engagement rate. That gives you a concrete next step: decide which posts are worth repeating or building on when planning the following week. Free Insights also includes a Last 30 days view.

The official Insights guide shows how that performance comparison works. It won’t determine which metrics your particular channels report, but it can help you judge whether this review step is useful before signing up.
